item.title: Firmware Management
item.description: Function Overview linkPlatform device firmware management, including firmware search, adding firmware, modifying firmware, downloading firmware, access authorization, generating redemption codes, etc. 1. Firmware Search link Advanced search can be performed based on device type or firmware name 2. Add firmware link Firmware version should not be too long, please make sure firmware file is legal, otherwise it will not be added 3. Other operations link 3.1 Modify firmware link 3.2 Delete firmware link 3.

item.title: Point Query
item.description: Function Overview linkQuery the device’s reporting of point data, and the latest data report will be displayed 1. Point Query Export link Enter the device serial number to query the device data Select the export time to export the data of a certain day

item.title: Batch Operation
item.description: Function Overview linkBatch parameter setting, firmware upgrade, command transmission, etc. for devices 1. Create a task link Can filter devices according to specified device type and power station Select the device type, select the device in the device list, and add the device Select the type of batch operation required and submit the task 2. Redo failed devices link If the batch operation task fails, you can use the redo function to redo the failed devices in the batch task.

item.title: Remote Interaction
item.description: Function Overview linkSend downlink commands to the collector, including firmware upgrade, command transmission, parameter setting The remote interaction interface displays the current online collector by default, and can also perform advanced search based on serial number, status, power station, tag, and firmware version number 1. Firmware Upgrade (OTA) link Firmware upgrade includes upgrading the collector and upgrading the sub-device. The upgrade process is the same, but the types of the two devices are different and the firmware used is different
